Subject: POC: HorizonCare - Success criteria & RACI / next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned heading into the POC: 

Summary of objectives
- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost against HorizonCare batch inference workloads (30-50k texts/day).
- Confirm private deployment options and KMS integration for PHI-like data.
- Demonstrate model accuracy on HorizonCare prompts and guardrail behavior for protected PHI fields.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or edit)
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for 128-token responses during peak 100 RPS test window.
2) Cost: Token cost improvement >= 25% vs current baseline using quantized model variant + caching.
3) Quality: F1 >= 0.85 on the 200-case evaluation set (we'll share prompt set).
4) Security: KMS-backed encryption in transit and at rest + SOC 2 attestation provided.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Align stakeholders, finalize test data and success criteria (owner: HorizonCare product).
- Week 1: Provision test environment (Redwood Dedicated sandbox).
- Week 2: Run smoke tests, instrumentation, and initial eval run.
- Week 3: Full load test and final evaluation, present results and handoff.

Ownership / RACI (draft)
- Redwood: infra provisioning, model deployment, runtime observability (owner: Redwood eng).
- HorizonCare App Team: provide eval prompts/dataset, define quality acceptance (owner: HorizonCare product).
- HorizonCare Security: review SOC2/KMS requirements and sign-off.
- HorizonCare Procurement: contract & procurement milestones.

Attachments: POC-MAP.xlsx (high-level timeline + responsibilities)

Next steps
1) Olivia / James: confirm success criteria and who will own the evaluation dataset by Tue 3/3.
2) Redwood: share RACI matrix v1 (Dev will draft) and calendar invite for kickoff (proposed 3/8).

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite after I hear back on owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
